benches.why: Dev list discussed AI-assisted contributions, AGENTS.md, and a disclosure checkbox in 2026.
Kafka dev list and pull requests are the third bench, parallel to Airflow and Flink.
Maintainers ended the curl bug bounty on 31 Jan 2026 after AI-generated reports overwhelmed the security team.

On 30 Jun 2026 the Godot Foundation said review was overwhelmed by AI-agent and AI-written pull requests, that vibe-coded submissions are already an auto-ban, and that new contributors need permission before a feature or large refactor. https://godotengine.org/article/contribution-policy-2026/

On 22 Jan 2026 Mitchell Hashimoto restricted AI-written contributions to accepted issues and maintainers, and banned repeat low-effort submissions, after saying bad content was up by about 10x. https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty/pull/10412

On 30 Sep 2026 Jeremy Soller said COSMIC would no longer accept LLM-written code, comments, or PR text because first-time LLM submissions were unplanned and rarely accepted. cosmic-epoch itself had 23 PRs in the year; cosmic-comp is the compositor and had 425. The pop-os org had 4363 PRs in the same window.

not_a_pr_bench.why: Piotr Karwasz, 25 Feb 2026: YesWeHack reports jumped to 17, 20, and 13 in Dec 2025-Feb 2026, against about 20 ordinary Log4j bugs in that quarter. The reports are not GitHub pull requests. https://github.com/apache/logging-log4j2/discussions/4052

Security team, Jan 2026: more than 30 HackerOne reports between 15 Dec 2025 and 15 Jan 2026, then a Signal 1.0 bar. The reported flood is the bounty inbox. https://nodejs.org/en/blog/announcements/hackerone-signal-requirement
